europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Moroccan families are debating a large influx of migrants into Ceuta, with Spain attributing the surge to criminal networks. The European Union has responded by offering solidarity and backing Spain's measures to manage the crisis.

europe_now.title: Heatwave Threatens European Nuclear Plants
europe_now.summary: Heatwave conditions are testing nuclear power plants in Romania, Hungary, and France, leading to operational challenges. The high temperatures threaten the safety and reliability of these facilities, prompting increased monitoring and potential shutdowns.

top_stories.title: Moscow Restaurant Bombing
top_stories.summary: A bombing at a Moscow restaurant has sparked nationalist fury over elite privilege and security failures. The incident has intensified discussions about domestic security and the perceived vulnerability of public spaces.

top_stories.title: Ukraine War Escalation
top_stories.summary: Ukraine's 40‑day offensive and Russia's missile attacks have escalated the conflict into a phase described as 'destroying civilisations.' The ongoing hostilities have intensified international concerns about regional stability.

top_stories.title: Togo Weapons Entry Point
top_stories.summary: Togo has become a new entry point for weapons sent by Russia to Mali, according to reports. This development raises concerns about the proliferation of arms in West Africa.

top_stories.title: Greek Wildfire Near Athens
top_stories.summary: Firefighters in Greece have gained ground against wildfires near Athens, but the blaze remains a significant threat. The incident highlights the increasing risk of wildfires in the region due to climate conditions.
